reason: Exact full-catalog integration after rev70 proved that reducing browser workers from four to two did not eliminate the timeout class: all three remaining timeouts were ES/390/reduced and spent about 24 seconds in the coarse lazy-load phase while matched profiles completed in about one second. The auditor now keeps the 25000 ms context budget unchanged, replaces renderer-side setTimeout scrolling with host-controlled viewport scroll steps, records deterministic scroll-plan mutations and explicit font-settle/lazy-traversal/post-scroll-settle/DOM-inspection timings, and retains fail-closed request/runtime listeners through teardown. The existing workflow has no three-route focused scope; running one existing exact-head full integration avoids introducing a second CI workflow. Require zero BROWSER_CONTEXT_TIMEOUT before BROWSER_PASS. SOURCE/RENDERED/MEDIA failures remain independent; PIXEL_REVIEW and PEDAGOGY_REVIEW remain editorial/revision-scoped; no GOLDEN status may be inferred from this technical run.
